title: About me
subtitle: One person who handles all of your IT — and takes responsibility for it
description: I'm an IT architect. For years in a corporate environment I designed systems, rolled out automation and trained teams. Today I work solo, directly with small business owners — you talk to the person who does the work, not a consultant who passes your case along. I don't sell hours. I take responsibility for your server, data and hardware working, so you can focus on your business.

highlights.title: A failure the vendor's support couldn't find
highlights.description: A small firm's accounting and inventory system was about to miss its month-end close. The software vendor's official support couldn't find the cause — I did. On top of that, I gave the client tools to handle it herself, without calling me.

highlights.title: Years of care over the whole infrastructure
highlights.description: A small trading company: for years I've looked after its server, database, backups, network and hardware-replacement plan. I know that infrastructure well enough to see what will break before you notice it.

highlights.title: Training for IT teams and non-technical people
highlights.description: I ran training in AI tools and technology at a global IT company — single sessions drew up to 2,000 people. I also run monthly sessions in the Brave community.
